integrity: The exact labelled facets are reconstructed independently. A determinant-one lattice certificate proves H1 is free of rank one, and an explicit integral cocycle classifies every nonfacial triangular cycle. Published homology is only a cross-check.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the labelled sixteen-vertex G5 triangulation and combinatorial edge-count length; no vertex-minimality or Riemannian systole claim is made. The 85/49 sign split is orientation-dependent up to global sign.
title: One hundred thirty-four primitive triangular systoles in the sixteen-vertex sixth-turn flat three-manifold
